project.name: SkillWeave Initiative 01 — Process Architecture and Bundle System
project.description: Redesign the SkillWeave lifecycle model with 7 explicit phases, modular bundle variants, entry point detection, and workflow recommendation

objectives.description: Define a 7-phase lifecycle model with clear boundaries, entry/exit conditions, and phase transitions
Create a modular bundle system supporting 5+ predefined bundle variants
Build entry point detection and workflow recommendation

tasks.title: Define lifecycle phase registry schema
tasks.description: Create the YAML schema for phase definitions including id, name, order, entry_conditions, exit_conditions, skills, and capabilities. Write as .skillweave/lifecycle/phases.yaml with all 7 phases fully specified.
acceptance_criteria: phases.yaml exists in .skillweave/lifecycle/
7 phases defined: discovery, blueprint, design, build, release, launch, post-release
Each phase has id, name, order, entry_conditions, exit_conditions
Each phase lists associated skills and required capabilities
Phase transitions are explicit and unambiguous
verification_steps: Validate YAML syntax
Verify all 7 phases present
Check each phase has required fields
Verify phase order is sequential

tasks.title: Define bundle variant configurations
tasks.description: Create bundle definitions for all 5 predefined variants (full-lifecycle, discovery-to-blueprint, design-and-build, release-and-launch, post-release-improvement). Each bundle specifies phases, entry requirements, recommended use case, and estimated effort.
acceptance_criteria: bundles.yaml exists in .skillweave/lifecycle/
5 predefined bundles defined with phase references
Each bundle has entry_requires, recommended_for, and estimated_effort
Bundle references valid phase IDs from phases.yaml
Custom bundle composition pattern documented
verification_steps: Validate YAML syntax
Verify all 5 bundles present
Cross-reference phase IDs with phases.yaml
Check entry requirements are testable

tasks.title: Implement entry point detection logic
tasks.description: Build a detection module that analyzes project artifacts to determine the user's current lifecycle stage. Checks for: PRD files, source code, test files, deployment configs, release notes, and other stage indicators. Returns a confidence-scored stage assessment.
acceptance_criteria: Detection module exists and is importable
Checks for presence of key artifacts per phase
Returns stage ID and confidence score (0-1)
Handles empty project (returns 'discovery' with high confidence)
Handles project with PRD but no code (returns 'blueprint' or 'design')
Handles project with code and tests (returns 'build' or 'release')
verification_steps: Run detection on empty directory
Run detection on project with only prd.md
Run detection on project with code + tests
Run detection on current SkillWeave repo

tasks.title: Implement workflow recommendation engine
tasks.description: Build a recommendation module that takes the detected stage and user's declared goal, then recommends the appropriate bundle variant and next concrete action. Integrates with existing intelligent detection system.
acceptance_criteria: Recommendation module exists and is importable
Takes detected_stage and goal as inputs
Returns recommended_bundle, next_action, and gap_analysis
Identifies prerequisites not yet met
Provides human-readable explanation for recommendation
Integrates with existing integrate_with_skill() function
verification_steps: Test: idea stage + 'build an app' goal → recommends full-lifecycle
Test: blueprint stage + 'ship it' goal → recommends release-and-launch with gap warning
Test: build stage + 'finish feature' goal → recommends design-and-build
Test: unknown stage → triggers onboarding flow

tasks.title: Implement phase-aware onboarding flow
tasks.description: Create an interactive onboarding flow that guides new users through stage identification, bundle selection, and first-step recommendation. State persists in .skillweave/ for session continuity.
acceptance_criteria: Onboarding asks about current stage, available artifacts, and goal
Onboarding recommends a bundle and starting skill
Onboarding state persists in .skillweave/onboarding-state.yaml
Onboarding can be skipped with a flag
Onboarding adapts questions based on detected artifacts
verification_steps: Run onboarding in empty project
Run onboarding in project with existing PRD
Verify state file is created
Verify skip flag works

tasks.title: Implement phase boundary enforcement
tasks.description: Add phase-awareness to skills so they can detect when invoked outside their intended phase and provide appropriate guidance. Enforcement is soft (recommends, does not block) with override option.
acceptance_criteria: Skills can declare their phase membership
Phase check runs before skill execution
Out-of-phase invocation triggers recommendation message
Override is possible with explicit parameter
Phase violations are logged to .skillweave/tracking-log/
verification_steps: Invoke release skill on project without code → triggers recommendation
Invoke blueprint skill on project with PRD → proceeds normally
Use override flag → proceeds despite phase mismatch
Check tracking log for phase violation entry

tasks.title: Integrate phase system with existing skill infrastructure
tasks.description: Connect the new phase registry, bundle system, and recommendation engine with the existing SkillWeave intelligent detection and skill integration systems. Ensure backward compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: integrate_with_skill() uses phase detection when available
.skillweave/config.yaml supports active_bundle and current_phase fields
Existing skill invocations work unchanged (backward compatible)
Phase system is opt-in — no impact when not configured
All existing tests continue to pass
verification_steps: Run existing test suite — all pass
Invoke skill without phase system → works as before
Invoke skill with phase system configured → enhanced behavior
Check config.yaml extension does not break existing parsing

tasks.title: Create test suite for lifecycle and bundle system
tasks.description: Comprehensive tests covering phase registry loading, bundle composition, entry detection, workflow recommendation, onboarding flow, phase boundary enforcement, and backward compatibility.
acceptance_criteria: Test file exists with 15+ test cases
Phase registry loading tests pass
Bundle composition tests pass
Entry detection tests pass for 5+ scenarios
Recommendation engine tests pass
Backward compatibility tests pass
All tests run without errors
verification_steps: Run test suite
Verify 15+ test cases exist
Verify all tests pass
Check coverage of core scenarios

assumptions.description: Current SkillWeave skill interfaces remain stable during redesign
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Integration work increases significantly, possible breaking changes
assumptions.validation_method: Review current skill API surface before starting

assumptions.description: 7-phase model covers all practical SkillWeave use cases
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: May need additional phases or different granularity
assumptions.validation_method: Map 5 real-world scenarios to the phase model

assumptions.description: Users will accept guided workflow over free-form skill invocation
assumptions.impact_if_wrong: Phase system may be ignored, reducing its value
assumptions.validation_method: Make phase system opt-in with clear value demonstration

technical: Must maintain backward compatibility with SkillWeave v0.5.x
Phase system must be opt-in, not mandatory
Configuration must use existing .skillweave/ directory structure
Must work across all supported agent frameworks

risks.description: Over-engineering the phase system with too much complexity
risks.mitigation: Start minimal with 7 phases max, iterate based on real usage

risks.description: Breaking existing SkillWeave workflows during integration
risks.mitigation: Backward compatibility as hard requirement, full test coverage

risks.description: Phase boundaries too rigid for real-world usage
risks.mitigation: Soft enforcement with override, log violations for learning

execution_recommendation.reason: 8 tasks, ~6 hours total, moderate dependencies with clear dependency chain
